SECTION 02 · SERVICES — FULL SPECIFICATION
================================================================================

SERVICE: GIS Consulting
  URL:   https://www.masonnguyengeo.com/services/gis-consulting
  Scope: End-to-end GIS advisory: platform selection, data modeling, pipeline
         architecture, team training, and ongoing strategic support.
  Tools: ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, QGIS, Google Earth Engine, PostGIS, GDAL
  Outcomes: Custom GIS environments, documented workflows, analyst-ready data products

SERVICE: Spatial Data Science
  URL:   https://www.masonnguyengeo.com/services/spatial-data-science
  Scope: Python-based spatial analytics, geostatistics, spatial modeling,
         data visualization, and machine learning on geographic datasets.
  Tools: Python (GeoPandas, Shapely, Rasterio, Fiona, Folium, Pyproj), R (sf, terra)
  Outcomes: Reproducible spatial analysis pipelines, maps, models, and dashboards

SERVICE: Remote Sensing
  URL:   https://www.masonnguyengeo.com/services/remote-sensing
  Scope: Satellite and aerial imagery acquisition, preprocessing, classification,
         change detection, and time-series analysis.
  Tools: Google Earth Engine, ENVI, SNAP, Sentinel-2, Landsat, Planet Labs API
  Outcomes: Classified raster datasets, change maps, vegetation indices, reports

SERVICE: Location Intelligence
  URL:   https://www.masonnguyengeo.com/services/location-intelligence
  Scope: Business site analysis, market boundary mapping, customer spatial
         segmentation, trade area analysis, and spatial decision support.
  Tools: ArcGIS Business Analyst, Esri Demographics, custom Python pipelines
  Outcomes: Site scoring models, competitor proximity maps, catchment analysis

SERVICE: GEO Optimization
  URL:   https://www.masonnguyengeo.com/services/geo-optimization

  - Python for geospatial analysis
  - GeoPandas tutorial and best practices
  - Spatial joins and overlay operations
  - Kernel density estimation (KDE) mapping
  - Spatial autocorrelation (Moran's I)
  - Interpolation methods (IDW, Kriging)
  - Point pattern analysis
  - Geocoding and address matching

Primary Topic Cluster: Remote Sensing
  - Satellite imagery analysis

SECTION 04 · FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
================================================================================

Q: What is Mason Nguyen's area of expertise?
A: Mason Nguyen specializes in geospatial analysis, GIS consulting, spatial
   data science, and remote sensing. He helps organizations use geographic
   data to make better decisions — from site selection to environmental
   monitoring to custom GIS pipeline development.

Q: Where is Mason Nguyen based?
A: Mason Nguyen is based in California and takes consulting engagements globally.

Q: What GIS software does Mason Nguyen work with?
A: Mason Nguyen works with ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, QGIS, Google Earth Engine,
   PostGIS, GDAL, and Python geospatial libraries including GeoPandas, Shapely,
   Rasterio, and Fiona.

Q: What is the difference between GIS consulting and spatial data science?
A: GIS consulting focuses on the systems, platforms, and workflows an organization
   uses to manage and analyze geographic data. Spatial data science uses statistical
   and machine learning methods applied to geographic datasets to extract insights
   and build predictive models. Mason Nguyen delivers both.

Q: What is remote sensing and how is it used?
A: Remote sensing is the acquisition and analysis of data about Earth's surface
   using satellite or aerial sensors — without direct physical contact. It is used
   for land cover mapping, vegetation monitoring, change detection, disaster
   response, and environmental assessment. Mason Nguyen provides remote sensing
   analysis using Sentinel-2, Landsat, and Google Earth Engine.

Q: How can I hire Mason Nguyen for a geospatial project?
A: Contact Mason Nguyen at mason@masonnguyengeo.com or visit
   https://www.masonnguyengeo.com/contact. He is available for project-based
   consulting engagements and longer-term advisory arrangements.

Q: What industries does Mason Nguyen serve?
A: Mason Nguyen serves clients in real estate, environmental consulting,
   urban planning, logistics, retail, agriculture, and public sector.
